key_insight: Making the decoder in latent diffusion video pipelines explicitly conditioned on the input/reference preserves structural detail and frame-to-frame consistency, closing a major gap caused by the common practice of using an unconditional decoder.
problem_solved: Fixes detail loss and inconsistency between generated video frames and the input/reference image that arises from architectural asymmetry (conditioned denoiser vs. unconditional decoder) in standard latent diffusion-based video generation.
method: Introduce RefDecoder: a decoder module that receives explicit conditioning from the reference image and temporal context (e.g., via cross-attention or conditioned feature injection) so decoding respects input structure.
Integrate RefDecoder into the latent diffusion pipeline so both the denoising network and the decoder are conditioned, improving fidelity and temporal coherence of generated video.
Train with reconstruction and temporal-consistency objectives to encourage the decoder to preserve spatial details and maintain cross-frame alignment.
impact: By restoring symmetry between denoiser and decoder conditioning, RefDecoder yields more faithful, consistent video outputs—making reference-guided generation and editing more reliable for practitioners building video synthesis, VFX, and content-creation tools.
visual_elements: Side-by-side pipeline diagram: standard latent diffusion (conditioned denoiser + unconditional decoder) vs. RefDecoder pipeline (both conditioned).
Before/after example sequence: input reference image → generated video with unconditional decoder vs. RefDecoder (highlighting preserved details).
Attention/feature overlay: visualization of decoder cross-attention to reference frames showing where structure is preserved.
Bar/line chart: qualitative/quantitative improvements in fidelity and temporal consistency (e.g., LPIPS, temporal warping error) between baseline and RefDecoder.
paper_title: RefDecoder: Enhancing Visual Generation with Conditional Video Decoding
paper_authors: Xiang Fan, Yuheng Wang, Bohan Fang, Zhongzheng Ren, Ranjay Krishna
